create_logger_config: create a LoggerConfig dataclass instance to configure experiment logging output directory and console settings
configure_wandb_logging: configure LoggerConfig with use_wandb enabled and set wandb_entity and wandb_project_name for wandb.ai integration
configure_json_logging: configure LoggerConfig with use_json enabled to save experiment logs locally in JSON format
configure_detailed_logging: configure LoggerConfig with detailed_logging enabled to log mean std min max statistics to wandb
validate_logger_config: validate a LoggerConfig instance by calling its validate method to check configuration correctness
